data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: DSO_SPRINT_MODE eliminated from apply-attribution-trailers.sh (GREEN phase)
- DD3: 4-cell matrix applied to attribution injection (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
In `plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh`, replace the DSO_SPRINT_MODE check with
dso.workflow + .sprint-active check in the SC-2 attribution.enabled guard (around line 471).

New logic: read dso.workflow via _read_config_path (already resolved in the script), check
for REPO_ROOT/.sprint-active file. If dso.workflow=ci-pr AND .sprint-active exists, treat
as sprint mode (bypass attribution.enabled guard). Otherwise respect attribution.enabled.

Remove DSO_SPRINT_MODE from all executable code and related comments.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] apply-attribution-trailers.sh no longer references DSO_SPRINT_MODE in executable code
  Verify: ! grep -q 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] apply-attribution-trailers.sh checks .sprint-active marker
  Verify: grep -q '\.sprint-active' plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] apply-attribution-trailers.sh reads dso.workflow via read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement apply-attribution-trailers.sh: replace DSO_SPRINT_MODE with dso.workflow=ci-pr + .sprint-active check
